sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 538 was established by Ordinance No. 23962, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 11, 1999. Ordinance No. 23962 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 538 is established on property bounded by West Commerce Street, Navarro Street, Pollard Street, and Vilbig Road. The size of PD 538 is approximately 1.18 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district.

(d) In this district, the provisions of Section 51A-4.203(3)(E)(iv) do not apply.

(e) In this district, the provisions of Section 51A-4.203(5)(E)(iv) do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 538A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other permitted uses, the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a conceptual plan, development plan, site analysis, or landscape plan do not apply, and no development plan is required. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted on the Property are as follows:

(1) Metal salvage facility.

(2) Outside salvage or reclamation.

(3) All other uses permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this planned development district by SUP only. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District is subject to DIR in this planned development district, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Home occupation. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is:

(1) five feet along Vilbig Road, 15 feet along West Commerce Street; and

(2) no minimum in all other cases.

(b) Side and rear yard. No minimum side or rear yard.

(c) Density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area. Maximum floor area ratio is:

(1) 0.5 for retail and personal service uses;

(2) 0.75 for any combination of lodging, office, and retail and personal service uses; and

(3) 2.0 for all uses combined.

(e) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in

Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is 110 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is eight. Parking garages are exempt from this requirement, but must comply with the height regulations of Subsection (e). (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) A minimum of five off-street parking spaces and one off-street loading space must be provided for a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, as shown on the development plan.

(b) For all other permitted uses, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy on the Property.

(b) For all other permitted uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Article X.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.111. SCREENING.

A minimum nine-foot-high solid screening fence that complies with Section 51A-4.203(3)(E)(i) must be provided around the perimeter of the Property as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Ingress - Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.113. INGRESS - EGRESS.

Ingress to and egress from the Property is prohibited along the Vilbig Road frontage. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The hours of operation for a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use are from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday through Friday, and 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Saturday.

(b) Metal crushing and shredding operations are prohibited as part of a metal salvage facility or an outside salvage or reclamation use.

(c) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a metal salvage facility or an outside salvage or reclamation use, a structure with a minimum of 19,500 square feet of floor area, a maximum height of 45 feet, and a minimum height of 35 feet, must be constructed for the storage of salvage materials. This structure must be built within that area identified as “building area” on the development plan, and, except for the setback area along Vilbig Road, the southernmost outside wall of the structure must extend along the entire length of the southern boundary line of the Property.

(d) For an outside salvage or reclamation use and a metal salvage facility, no objects may be stacked higher than eight feet within 40 feet of the nine-foot-high visual screen. Objects may be stacked one foot higher than eight feet for each additional five feet of setback. In no case may objects stacked outside of a covered structure on the Property exceed 20 feet in height.

(e) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(f) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-538.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 538 is located on Zoning Map No. K-6. (Ord. Nos. 23962; 25163)
